name: 103. Stream chunks carry only delta - no message object or empty reasoning noise (#7294) (stream-chunk-shape)
description: Issue #7294: with a DeepSeek-shaped OpenAI-compatible upstream (ModelScope), every streamed /v1/chat/completions chunk carried a full `message` object next to `delta` plus empty reasoning, reasoning_content, and reasoning_details fields on content-phase chunks. Bifrost passed the message object through (BifrostResponseChoice decodes both embedded shapes) and amplified the empty reasoning noise (UnmarshalJSON folded "" into a non-nil Reasoning, synthesized an empty details entry, and MarshalJSON re-emitted both spellings). Reasoning-aware clients rendered a fresh "[Thinking 0.0s]" block between every piece of the answer. Fixed by normalizing empty reasoning to absent in the schema unmarshalers and dropping the non-stream choice shape whenever a delta is present in the OpenAI-family stream loop. 103.1 pins the chunk shape on the plain OpenAI path; 103.2 pins it on a reasoning-emitting model and additionally asserts real (non-empty) reasoning deltas still stream, guarding against over-pruning.
